svg.aria-label: Weekly GitHub contributions for the last 12 months: personal account AnthonyLedesma as solid phosphor bars, and work accounts AnthonyLedesmaTR and anthonyl-mf (private repos, counts only) summed as hatched bars stacked on top, on one linear scale. A pixel runner crosses, bumping each week, with a +1 over the busiest combined weeks, then stands at the right edge, and runs again every 20 seconds. Updated daily.
